sentence: And the market's perception is itself an environment: reactions to AI-heavy service patents in manufacturing are negative, softened by idiosyncratic volatility
passage: [Patel (2026), p. 1] "stock market reactions to service technology patents with high AI scores are negative" / "we find that idiosyncratic volatility mitigates this negative reaction, while tangibility shows no such effect."

gemini.note: The passage supports the claims about negative market reactions and the mitigating role of idiosyncratic volatility, but does not specify that this applies specifically to manufacturing.
